name: ChartTable
description:
Every chart carries its data as a table. Hidden, it gives screen readers the values the
picture shows; visible ("View as table"), it replaces the plot in the same box and scrolls
inside it.

props.name: model
props.description: Selected assistant model or typed view model.

props.name: visible
props.description: Visible "View as table" mode, or the always-present visually hidden fallback.
